When is the best time to visit New Zealand?

Depends which New Zealand you want! December to February brings long, warm days for hiking, while June to August turns the South Island into a snowy playground. Are you chasing sunshine or ski slopes?

What are some cultural norms I should know in Thailand?

Lovely question, and asking it already makes you a better guest! Dress modestly at temples, never touch anyone's head, and return a wai greeting with a smile. Are you planning to visit temples, or is this more of a beaches-and-street-food trip?
